_rationale.entryJavaScriptGzipBytes: Studio crash recovery and invalid-response validation measure 175.6 kB gzip / 618.6 kB raw in CI. Allow 500 additional gzip bytes for these recovery controls. See docs/qa/studio-recovery-budget-2026-09-09.md.
_rationale.totalJavaScriptGzipBytes: Studio recovery measures 309.4 kB aggregate gzip in CI. The 500-byte increase accommodates the recovery controls; content payload and lazy-editor boundaries remain enforced. See docs/qa/studio-recovery-budget-2026-09-09.md.
_rationale.entryJavaScriptRawBytes: The null-response guard and bounded inventory retries bring the entry to 618.6 kB raw in CI. Allow 500 additional raw bytes at entry and for the largest chunk. See docs/qa/studio-recovery-budget-2026-09-09.md.
